[P2] Test the actual GitHub deletion gate

The new tests supply `isClosed` as an already-computed boolean and never exercise `gitHubIsClosed`. Inverting this comparison would delete open-PR stacks while every committed test still passed. The earlier cleanup-eligibility coverage finding therefore remains unresolved under CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Following rule 9, revisit the test boundary in the design phase: mock the HTTP response and exercise the real open/closed/error decision before permitting deletion.
